description: Source code for the NCP5623 LED driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing LED control over I2C with functions for setting color, brightness, and initialization.

methods.name: ncp5623_led_to_info
methods.description: Retrieves LED info structure for a given LED index.

methods.name: ncp5623_get_info
methods.description: Gets information about a specific LED.

methods.name: ncp5623_set_color
methods.description: Sets the color of a specific LED.

methods.name: ncp5623_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of a specific LED.

methods.name: ncp5623_led_on
methods.description: Turns on the LED at full brightness.
